title: MUSIC STARTS AT 60%
why: His answer 36 (2026-10-12): menu music at 60%. The music (the title, the demo attract and the Undercroft; there is no music in a raid) now starts at 60% out of the box. Settings has a new 60% step between 50% and 75%, and anyone who already picked a level keeps exactly that level.
now: The music now starts at 60%, with a 60% step in Settings.
